Maya R.: Quick thread  saw a P95 regression on /v1/generate at 01:14 UTC. Need a short SLO exception + owners for fixes and dashboard changes.

Theo (oncall): Error budget up ~20% in last 6h. P95 ~3x normal for ~15m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/serve-latency.

Khaled A.: Root traces show increased batching from ingress during node churn. Likely scale-down race. I'll take batching config + canary. Creating ticket INF-3142. ETA 48h.

Iris L.: I'll update dashboards and add a panel for node_age + batch_window. PR today. Also adding alert: batch_window_spike.

Maya R.: Proposal: temporary P95 SLO raise 210ms -> 270ms for 48h; stop paging for P95 while we roll. Keep P99. Approve?

Theo (oncall): OK to approve 48h. I'll patch alerts (threshold + suppression) and post PR link.

OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-327 created (automated): ingress batching spike. Severity: Sev3. Pager muted.

Khaled A.: Canary started (5 nodes):
```
batch_max_ms: 8
prewarm=true
```
Will report perf after 30m.

Iris L.: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/dashboards/pulls/523. Added node_age and batch_window panels.

Theo (oncall): Alert PR merged. Monitoring error budget. Early signal: burn falling to 5% in 4h.

Khaled A.: Canary stable, rolling to 25% traffic. INF-3142 updated -> in_progress.

Maya R.: Summary: Khaled owns INF-3142 (48h), Iris owns dashboards/runbook edits (ETA EOD), Theo owns alert changes. Temporary SLO exception applied at 01:30 UTC with rollback at +48h. We'll reconvene if any regression.

Theo (oncall): No regressions in 12h. Will post final status at 24h then close loop if stable.

(End of thread)
